overview.heading: Cancellation of Admission
overview.text: The cancellation of admission is not permissible. However, under special circumstances, such cancellation may be considered as per the guidelines shown here.
highlights: Refund depends on timing of cancellation

reference.heading: Reference
reference.text: SOP, Academic Guideline, October 2020. For any cancellation request, please contact the Admission Office.

refund_schedule.heading: Refund Schedule
refund_schedule.subheading: Refundable amount by time of cancellation

rules.refundable: 100% of the Establishment Fees and 100% of the Semester Fee

rules.when: Within the 1st week of commencement of the classes
rules.refundable: The Caution Money, 75% of the Establishment Fee and the Semester Fee

rules.when: Within 2 weeks of commencement of the classes
rules.refundable: The Caution Money, 50% of the Establishment Fee and the Semester Fee

rules.when: After 2 weeks of commencement of the classes
